description: Secretary Hegseth installed a grand piano and put lobster on the menu while sailors on the USS Lincoln slept in broken bunks. The administration is asking for a $1.5 trillion defense budget for FY2027. Reaper drones are being lost at a 25% rate. And the CIA's own analysts rated the intel that rerouted Air Force One as low confidence. This is what two Americas looks like.

title: Two Americas: Lobster at the Pentagon, Broken Bunks on the Lincoln — Travis Jack Stevens for U.S. Senate
